desc: Parse a dotted IPv4 address. Split s on ".": if that does not give exactly 4 parts, return "expected 4 parts". Each part must be 1 to 3 decimal digits (no signs or other characters), must not have a leading zero unless it is exactly "0", and must be at most 255. Otherwise return "bad part: P" for the first invalid part P, in order (P may be empty). For parts a, b, c, d return a*16777216 + b*65536 + c*256 + d.

decls.ts: type Result<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; error: string };
